_note: BLANK TEMPLATE. The ingest copies this into each run as the starting point for session.json; you can also fill it by hand from the photos and card stubs, then build with: python3 build/build.py <your session.json> --out playbook/index.html. Set meta.status to 'draft' for the review (empty slots and source tags show) and 'final' to publish (empty sections hide; the build refuses gaps that matter). One challenge per table to start; when two tables tackled the same challenge, merge them into one entry with both table numbers. Ids are short slugs (they become page addresses).

_fields.themes[]: Sheet 1 'Every challenge at this table' from all tables, grouped. {id, label, tables:[n], heard:['short phrases as written']}
_fields.challenges[].title: Sheet 1 'The one we're tackling' (also on the tent card)
_fields.challenges[].theme: id of the theme it belongs to
_fields.challenges[].summary: 1-2 sentences on why it's hard, from Sheet 1 and the side sheet
_fields.challenges[].context: sectors, from the table's industry tally if one is collected (see the workflow doc); no organisation sizes
_fields.challenges[].quotes[]: side sheet Quotes column: {text (exact words), src}; no attribution unless a sector is written next to the quote
_fields.challenges[].lessons[]: Sheet 2 'If we did it again, we'd...'
_fields.challenges[].actions[]: Sheet 3 boxes: {title, what, needs, sticks, stages: [starting|growing|established], src}
_fields.challenges[].resources[]: side sheet Resources column: {title, url, source}; check every link
_fields.commitments[]: card stubs: {text, name (only if written on the card), org (only if written), challenge: <challenge id or null>, src}
_fields.resources[]: general reading not tied to one challenge: {title, url (optional: without one it shows as text), source, src}
_fields.quotes[]: Heard on the day, on the front page: {text (word for word), src, tables:[n], challenge: <challenge id or null>}
_fields.src: optional on any object item, e.g. 'T07 · Sheet 2'. Shown only in draft so lines can be checked against the paper
_fields.meta.table_names: {"13": "Virtual"}: a table shown by name, not number ("the Virtual table"). It keeps its number for the ring and the counts
_fields.meta.supporters: [{name, url, logo}] shown in the footer; logo files go in supporters/ beside your playbook.config.json, as <logo>-light.svg and <logo>-dark.svg
_fields.meta.hero: {file, alt}: an optional photo across the top of the homepage. alt text is required
